interface.shortDescription: Shared team knowledge, maintained in Confluence
interface.longDescription: Turn curated sources into linked, cited team knowledge in Confluence. Set up a dedicated space per team, ingest evidence, answer questions, review changes, and maintain wiki health while preserving human contributions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help set up Team Wiki for my team in Confluence, reusing an existing wiki when available.

name: team-wiki
description: Build and maintain a collaborative LLM wiki for each team under a shared Confluence root.
